name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code CLI and VS Code extension inside a devcontainer, with a config shared between all devcontainers and independent from the host's own Claude Code

managed-claude-md.description: Deploy the feature's CLAUDE.md at Claude Code's managed level (/etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md).

managed-settings-json.description: Deploy the feature's settings.json at Claude Code's managed level (/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json).
